text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — Strix beta cohort hitting SSO failures during account setup. two seats blocked (strix-101, strix-102).
Sam Patel: do we have logs from the Identity proxy?
Maria Chen: pushing the error snippet from yesterday: 
```
ERROR 2024-06-23 14:12:03 auth: oidc callback 400 invalid_grant
request_id=abc123 client_id=strix-prod
```
Jordan Lee: looks like token exchange failing, probably redirect_uri mismatch or clock skew. can we ask Strix to re-check the app config and timezone on their SSO provider?
Maria Chen: i already asked, they said apps look correct. sharing their reply: "We only changed a redirect for staging last week, production unchanged."
Jordan Lee: ok let's run a quick replicated flow from our side. Sam, can you run the OIDC flow against a test Strix tenant and paste curl trace?
Sam Patel: on it. brief curl to test token endpoint: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://auth.strix.com/oauth/token \
  -d 'grant_type=authorization_code&code=...&redirect_uri=https://app.redwood.ai/cb'
```
Sam Patel: trace shows 400 with body `{"error":"invalid_grant","error_description":"Redirect URI mismatch"}`
Olivia Park: if it's redirect uri mismatch then we need customer action. schedule enablement call to walk them through the app config? i'd prefer a short screen share rather than back-and-forth slack.
Maria Chen: agree. propose 30m enablement slot tomorrow 10:30am PT. i can run admin walkthrough.
Olivia Park: works for me. Jordan, can you join for the debug portion?
Jordan Lee: yes 10:30 PT ok. i'll bring the diagnostic checklist.
Maria Chen: i'll send calendar invite and include this quick pre-call checklist: 
- confirm production redirect URI = https://app.redwood.ai/oauth/callback
- check client's SSO provider logs for rejected redirect URI
- verify server clock within 2 mins of NTP
- have an admin on the call who can edit app config
Maria Chen: also capture feedback during the call in this short form so we can track recurring onboarding blockers: https://redwood.app/strix-onboard-feedback
Sam Patel: added a quick debugging snippet to help if they can't change redirect quickly — we can temporarily add a compat redirect on our side, but need PM signoff.
Olivia Park: PM signoff: we can allow a 24-48h compat redirect if customer is in good standing. Maria, flag renewal risk if they ask for long-term workaround.
Maria Chen: noted. i'll mark action items: 
- Maria: send invite + pre-call checklist + feedback form (ASAP)
- Jordan: diagnostic checklist + debug steps (before call)
- Sam: prepare temporary compat redirect plan + security notes
Olivia Park: i'll draft a one-paragraph approval for compat redirect and send to infra-sig for emergency exception.
OnboardBot: Reminder: Strix enablement session scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PT — meeting created by Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. quick pulse — react with :thumbsup: if you're good, else drop conflicts.
Sam Patel: :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Olivia Park: :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: great — i'll update the thread after the call with outcomes and next steps.
